text_simplified: When the relationship between parents and child falters, it becomes important to find ways to express feelings. You can strengthen trust and the bond between you by spending enjoyable time together and understanding the child’s needs. Avoid harshness and giving up, and focus on small steps and achievable goals. Listen to your child’s opinions and learn from your mistakes together.
